other_conditions: Applicant must be the dependent or nominee of a deceased worker.
The deceased worker must have been confirmed to have silicosis by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana.
The deceased worker must have been employed in a factory or at a construction site.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹15,000 is provided to the dependent/nominee of a deceased silicosis‑affected worker for performing funerary rituals.
documents_required: certificate of being the widow/widower or nominee (if applicable)
